page: Microsoft Azure M48bs_v3 is a memory-optimized virtual machine running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The instance is powered by an Intel Xeon 8473C x86_64 processor operating at up to 4.0 GHz, offering 48 dedicated vCPUs mapped across 24 physical cores with two threads per core. Cache hierarchy includes 48 KB of L1 data cache per core, 2 MB of L2 cache per core, and a shared 105 MB L3 cache. Hardware feature support is extensive, incorporating Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX tile and int8) alongside AVX-512 instructions (including VNNI and BF16) and cryptographic extensions such as VAES and SHA-NI.

System memory totals 384.0 GB, delivering an 8:1 memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU. Benchmark testing highlights solid memory subsystem throughput, achieving 3826.53 GB/sec in small cached block reads and 214.82 GB/sec in large 256 MB block reads, paired with 94.29 GB/sec in write throughput. In compute benchmarks, the instance yields a PassMark CPU score of 60379.92 and a Geekbench multi-core score of 19356.0, showing particular strength in image processing, compilation tasks, and database operation routines.

The M48bs_v3 contains no bundled local storage and includes zero integrated GPUs, relying entirely on remote Azure Premium Storage and managed block storage volumes for persistent data. This architectural choice makes storage IOPS and latency dependent on external network storage configuration, though it offers high deployment flexibility. In terms of cost efficiency, the instance provides high RAM density and dedicated compute resources suited for memory-bound applications without paying overhead for unused local disks or hardware accelerators.

Given its hardware specifications and benchmark performance, the M48bs_v3 is well suited for enterprise database engines, in-memory caches, large-scale data transformation, and moderate machine learning inference workloads leveraging Intel AMX.
description: Microsoft Azure M48bs_v3 is a memory-optimized virtual machine powered by an Intel Xeon 8473C processor running on Microsoft Hyper-V. The system provides 48 dedicated vCPUs across 24 physical cores at 4.0 GHz, supported by a 105 MB L3 cache and advanced instruction sets including AMX and AVX-512. It features 384.0 GB of RAM, maintaining an 8.0 GB per vCPU ratio, which drives strong memory bandwidth results of 214.82 GB/sec for uncached read blocks. The instance does not include local disk storage or GPU accelerators, depending instead on Azure Premium Block Storage for persistent volumes. Benchmarks indicate high performance across Geekbench compilation, image processing, and PassMark database operations, with steady results in multi-threaded decompression. The M48bs_v3 represents an efficient allocation of compute and memory for memory-intensive enterprise workloads, including large relational databases, in-memory caching systems, and CPU-based inference pipelines.
